Phase 1: package format and manifest
PackageManifest (format, created_at, schema, spec, sets, parts, posters)
LatestPointer published in the clear as latest.json
associated_data: minified JSON over format, created_at, key_id, schema, spec
poster_key_is_valid: tmdb-movie-{id} / tmdb-tv-{id} against a strict charset
package_file_name: YYYYMMDD plus the ciphertext sha256 prefix, taken as raw bytes
pointer_is_readable: validates every pointer field reaching a cipher, a file name or an allocation
Phase 2: export, archive and encrypt
Read-only index copy: a snapshot variant that writes nothing and runs no migration
Posters reuse the exact path and query resolve cached, because the cache key hashes path plus sorted query
